decisive_items: 10-cm mass of the organ of Zukerkandl (1984)
response.rationale: The presence of an SDHB gene variant and a history of a mass in the organ of Zukerkandl support the diagnosis of SDHB-related paraganglioma, making C1 the champion.

rejected.why: Lack of direct evidence for prostatic paraganglioma as the primary diagnosis
